description_en: Queries the details list of a specified domain name task by paging
description_zh: 调用QueryTaskDetailList分页查询指定域名任务的详情列表
name: QueryTaskDetailList

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
0: Waiting to be executed.
1: Executing.
2: Successful.
3: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：
0：等待执行。
1：执行中。
2：成功。
3：失败。
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the operation. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The task number. This is the TaskNo value returned by a successfully executed task
parameters.help_zh: 任务编号：已成功执行的任务返回的TaskNo参数值
parameters.name: task_no

parameters.help_en:
The domain name instance ID.

You can call <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442021.html</props><props="intl">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121704.html</props> to query the domain name instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例编号。

域名实例编号可通过<props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442021.html</props><props="intl">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121704.html</props>
接口查询
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The user IP address. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.name: page_size

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

ErrorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the task execution fails

FailReason.description_en: The detailed reason for the domain name task failure
FailReason.description_zh: 域名任务失败原因详情
FailReason.example: Domain has a purchase record in Wanwang reservation.

TaskResult.description_en: The task result, which records the result of certain task types after execution
TaskResult.description_zh: 任务执行结果，用于记录部分任务类型执行后的任务结果

TaskStatus.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
WAITING_EXECUTE: Waiting to be executed.
EXECUTING: Executing.
EXECUTE_SUCCESS: Executed successfully.
EXECUTE_FAILURE: Execution failed
TaskStatus.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
WAITING_EXECUTE：等待执行。
EXECUTING：执行中。
EXECUTE_SUCCESS：执行成功。
EXECUTE_FAILURE：执行失败

TaskStatusCode.description_en:
The task status code. Valid values:
0: Waiting to be executed.
1: Executing.
2: Executed successfully.
3: Execution failed
TaskStatusCode.description_zh:
任务状态码。取值：
0：等待执行。
1：执行中。
2：执行成功。
3：执行失败

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
CHG_HOLDER: Modify registrant information.
CHG_DNS: Modify DNS.
SET_WHOIS_PROTECT: Set privacy protection.
UPDATE_ADMIN_CONTACT: Modify administrator information.
UPDATE_BILLING_CONTACT: Modify billing contact information.
UPDATE_TECH_CONTACT: Modify technical contact information.
SET_UPDATE_PROHIBITED: Set the domain name security lock.
SET_TRANSFER_PROHIBITED: Set the transfer prohibition lock.
ORDER_ACTIVATE: Create a registration order.
ORDER_RENEW: Create a renewal order.
ORDER_REDEEM: Create a redemption order.
CREATE_DNSHOST: Create a DNS host.
UPDATE_DNSHOST: Update a DNS host.
SYNC_DNSHOST: Synchronize a DNS host
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
CHG_HOLDER：修改所有者信息。
CHG_DNS：修改DNS。
SET_WHOIS_PROTECT：设置隐私保护。
UPDATE_ADMIN_CONTACT：修改管理者信息。
UPDATE_BILLING_CONTACT：修改付费者信息。
UPDATE_TECH_CONTACT：修改技术者信息。
SET_UPDATE_PROHIBITED：设置域名安全锁。
SET_TRANSFER_PROHIBITED：设置域名转移锁。
ORDER_ACTIVATE：创建注册订单。
ORDER_RENEW：创建续费订单。
ORDER_REDEEM：创建赎回订单。
CREATE_DNSHOST：创建DNS host。
UPDATE_DNSHOST：更新DNS host。
SYNC_DNSHOST：同步DNS host

TaskTypeDescription.description_en: The description of the task type

TryCount.description_en: The number of retries for the task detail

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the task details were last executed
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次任务详情执行时间

NextPage.description_en: Indicates whether a next page exists

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

PrePage.description_en: Indicates whether a previous page exists
